name: Nestswipe: Production backup failed or overdue
message:
A backup failed or the Saturday 03:00 Europe/Paris backup is missing after six hours. Inspect /var/log/nestswipe-backup.log and /var/lib/nestswipe-backup/last-result. Preserve existing archives; do not start another backup blindly.

If this check stops reporting for 20 minutes, investigate the host Agent and nestswipe-security-report.timer.
